info.name: External Library Generation Service Generation Operations API
Returns the list of generation operations.

items.docs:
Gets the list of all available generation operations.

API Client needs at least one permission.

info.name: Generate an external library from a high-code package.

items.docs:
Asynchronously generates an external library using the HighCode package, containing the compiled code of the library.

Required permissions:
 - If generation operation corresponds to a new library: **Asset management > Create**
 - If generation operation corresponds to a new version of an existing library: **Asset management > Change** for that specific library key

info.name: Returns the details of a generation operation.

items.docs:
Returns the details of a generation operation its key.

API Client needs at least one permission.

Deletes a specific generation operation and all associated logs.

Required permissions:
 - If generation operation corresponds to a new library: **Asset management > Create**
 - If generation operation corresponds to a new version of an existing library: **Asset management > Change** for that specific library key

info.name: Returns the contents of the specified generation operation.

items.docs:
Returns the actions and structures defined on the high code package corresponding to the specified generation operation

Required permissions:
 - If generation operation corresponds to a new library: **Asset management > Create**
 - If generation operation corresponds to a new version of an existing library: **Asset management > Change** for that specific library key

Returns the validation messages for the specified generation operation.

Required permissions:
 - If generation operation has no library key associated (failed to get extracted from high code): **Asset management > Create** or **Asset management > Change**
 - If generation operation corresponds to a new library: **Asset management > Create**
 - If generation operation corresponds to a new version of an existing library: **Asset management > Change** for that specific library key
